tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: List catalog packs. Optional filters: profession, platform, status (listed|submitted|verified), tier (pilot|calibration|verified|verified+|reference).

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Get one pack by slug, including its EU AI Act checklist and verification block if any.

tools.name: search_packs
tools.description: Full-text search over pack name, vendor and summary.

tools.name: list_professions
tools.description: List professions with their decision types and AI Act high-risk flag.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List measured tasks: the yes/no question each pack answers, the case type, and the sealed golden set versions (hash and count only; cards are never public).

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Get the register facts as key-value groups: scope, counts, method thresholds, prices, data rules and agent endpoints. Same content as the /facts page.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_packs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
